content: eBay policy prohibits counterfeit/replica items and title/search manipulation (keywords unrelated to actual item), and prohibits mixing different conditions/brands in one bundle listing — but does not itself provide a canonical exclusion keyword list; sellers of genuinely damaged/lot/bundle product still use plain-language terms in titles (lot, bundle, x2/x3, set of, damaged, dented, resealed, opened, empty box, no cards, replica, custom, fan made, proxy) consistent with PITFALLS.md's own examples. No new terms beyond PITFALLS.md's set were found from authoritative sources this session.
